title: Empty a small trash can

steps.text: Carry the small can or pull out the bag.
steps.tip: Hold the bag at the top so nothing spills.

steps.text: Empty it into the big kitchen trash.
steps.tip: If the bag is full, tie it first.

steps.text: Put a new bag in and return the can.
steps.tip: Push the bag down into the corners.

done_when: Small can is empty with a bag in it
Can is back in its spot
parent_notes: Not for kitchen grease, bathroom, or pet waste in v1. Kid-sized cans only.
